def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Three independent rows of zero markers. Fill only the intervals matching the
    # demonstrated alternating sequence, in which each background gap becomes 2.
    bg=max(set(sum(grid,[])), key=sum(grid,[]).count)
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        js=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if len(js)>=2:
            for a,b in zip(js,js[1:]):
                if b==a+2 and row[a+1]==bg:
                    out[i][a+1]=2
    return out
PY
